item1.justification: The §103 analysis consistently invokes Graham v. John Deere factors (scope/content of prior art, differences, PHOSITA level, secondary considerations) and KSR-style motivation-to-combine reasoning throughout all claim analyses, with no misapplication of §101 or other statutes.

item2.justification: All conclusions reference specific prior art references (US-2013101804-A1, US-2012268412-A1), specific structural features (skin layer 420, elevations E, recesses R), and specific claim language (e.g., 'running elevation and/or depression,' UV-curing coating material, inkjet ink), satisfying the evidence-linkage requirement.

item3.justification: Stage consistency is maintained: claims found novel at §102 (11, 12, 13, 15, 16) are found non-obvious at §103 and allowed, while claims found to lack novelty at §102 (10, 17, 18, 19) or partially anticipated (14) are rejected as obvious, with no contradictory reversals between stages.

item4.justification: The examiner's high strictness (0.875) and low combination_threshold (0.344) are explicitly invoked in the reasoning—rejecting ambiguous claims firmly and stating 'combination_threshold=0.34로 낮아 공지상식 수준의 결합도 허용됨'—while nonetheless granting claims with clearly non-obvious UV-curing/inkjet features, which is appropriate since that evidence is unambiguous rather than borderline.

item5.justification: The final decision to reject claims 10, 14, 17, 18, 19 and suggest amendment for 11, 12, 13, 15, 16 directly follows from the accumulated §102/§103 stage analyses without any unexplained reversal, with detailed per-claim rationale consistent with all prior-stage findings.
